title: Sanitation kit
summary: What a household or group needs for a two-bucket toilet, bagged waste, cat holes and clean hands when the water and sewer are off.

items.text: Two 5-gallon (19 L) buckets with lids that close well, marked “pee” and “poo”
items.note: One for pee, one for poo. Keep them apart.

items.text: A toilet seat that fits on the buckets
Heavy-duty 13-gallon (49 L) garbage bags to line the poo bucket, and several boxes of heavy-duty 3 to 5 mil black garbage or contractor bags
items.note: The 3 to 5 mil bags are for double-bagging full liners, diapers and pads.

items.text: Cover material: sawdust, wood shavings, shredded paper, bark chips or peat moss
items.note: About half a cup (120 mL) after each poo.

items.text: A plastic scoop for the cover material
A separate garbage can with a tight lid, for the bagged toilet waste
Zipper bags, for used toilet paper and wipes and for packing out waste
Disposable latex or nitrile gloves for bagging waste; rubber gloves and eye protection for cleaning with bleach
Hand sanitizer with at least 60% alcohol
items.note: For when there is no water. Soap and water clean better.

items.text: A water jug with an on/off spigot, towels and a catch bucket, for a hand-washing station
Plain, unscented household bleach (5% to 9%), for cleaning the buckets
items.note: Never pour it into a bucket with pee in it. Never mix bleach with ammonia or any other cleaner.

items.text: A small garden trowel for cat holes, and a shovel for a latrine

sources.name: Oregon State University Extension Service, Survival Basics: Sanitation and Waste Management (EM 9334, October 2021)
